Local video assets for the portfolio

Place browser-friendly video files in this directory and reference them as /assets/videos/<filename>.
Recommended formats: MP4 (H.264 video + AAC audio), WebM (VP8/VP9 + compatible audio), or OGV/OGG. M4V is accepted for static local files when its codecs are supported by the browser.

There is no universal browser support for every extension. Convert AVI, MKV, WMV, FLV, and unsupported MOV/codec combinations to MP4 (H.264/AAC) or WebM before publishing. Match filename case exactly. Files inside dist/assets/videos are deployed with the rest of the static assets by Wrangler.
